Definition: from G4621 and G3358; a grain-measure, i.e. (by implication) ration (allowance of food):--portion of meat.
BiblicalUsage: Sitometron is the portion of meat, the ration measured out in due season, and it appears once, in the parable of the faithful steward: who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe faithfulness is measured in portions and seasons, because the steward's job was to feed the household on time, not to feast himself.
